products.name: Mass Yield - Inzane in the Membrane - 1G Pre-roll
products.description: Mass Yield presents Inzane in the Membrane, a premium 1g sativa pre-roll designed to energize and inspire. This expertly crafted flower pre-roll delivers an uplifting cerebral experience perfect for daytime activities, creative pursuits, or social gatherings. As a sativa-dominant strain, Inzane in the Membrane offers focused, euphoric effects that enhance productivity while keeping your mind clear and engaged. The pre-roll format provides convenient, ready-to-enjoy consumption with no grinding or rolling required. Mass Yield's commitment to quality ensures a smooth, flavorful smoke with every session. Whether you're looking to boost creativity, stay motivated, or simply elevate your day, this 1g pre-roll delivers consistent sativa effects in a portable, discreet package. Perfect for on-the-go cannabis enthusiasts seeking energetic, uplifting experiences.

products.name: Mass Yield - El Jefe - 1G Pre-roll
products.description: Mass Yield presents El Jefe, a premium 1g hybrid preroll designed for balanced cannabis enthusiasts. This expertly crafted preroll delivers the best of both worlds—combining uplifting cerebral effects with soothing physical relaxation. El Jefe's hybrid profile makes it ideal for any time of day, whether you're seeking creative focus or unwinding after work. The flower showcases a complex flavor profile with earthy, spicy notes complemented by subtle hints of pine and pepper. Expect a smooth, satisfying smoke that delivers euphoric and relaxed effects without overwhelming sedation. Perfect for solo sessions or sharing with friends, this convenient preroll requires no grinding or rolling—just light and enjoy. Mass Yield's commitment to quality ensures consistent potency and flavor in every puff. El Jefe is your go-to choice for versatile hybrid effects in a ready-to-smoke format.

products.name: Mass Yield - Rasta Pie - 3.5G Flower
products.description: Mass Yield presents Rasta Pie, a premium indica flower that delivers deep relaxation and tranquil vibes in every 3.5g jar. This hand-selected pre-pack showcases dense, resinous buds with a captivating aroma profile blending sweet tropical notes with earthy undertones and hints of spice. Rasta Pie's indica dominance makes it ideal for evening use, promoting full-body relaxation, relief from tension, and a peaceful sense of calm that melts away stress. Users can expect euphoric yet grounding effects that ease both mind and body into a state of pure contentment. The rich, complex flavor delivers smooth herbal notes with sweet, fruity accents on the exhale. Perfect for unwinding after a long day or enhancing quiet moments of reflection, this strain offers the quality and consistency Mass Yield is known for. Each 3.5g package preserves peak freshness and potency, ensuring an exceptional cannabis experience from first spark to last.
